title: The spawn guard's model refusal names every accepted reviewer form, and says round 1 and the test-author run on their role's model
why: Coordinator 17:21 CST Nov 8 (lane guard-fix-check-sonnet's pick 2); Merge after: #2342 (the spawn guard accepts a `Fix check` brief). Incident: lane merge-ready-uses-pin (#2303) had Sonnet refused for its test-author, its round 1 and its fix checks, fell back to Haiku against owner item 444 a, and #2303 now needs a fresh chain. Fix: the refusal names each accepted form (a reviewer brief whose first line is `Round 2 of 3`, `Round 3 of 3` or `Round N of 3 (fix check)`) and says that round 1 and the test-author run on their role's model. Red case: the refusal text for a Sonnet round-1 reviewer names those forms.
note: #2296 was replaced by #2342 (coordinator 17:58 CST Nov 8). Notes (coordinator, 04:54 CST Nov 9): (1) the reviewer refusal for an unranked model names forms that cannot lift it; main does the same. (2) The `*_NOTE` constants share a name with the glossary term `note`. Note (coordinator, 07:34 CST Nov 9): the spawn guard (agent-role-model) refused a Sonnet fix check whose brief line 1 was `Round 1 of 3 (fix check)` and wanted `Fix check`; main's docs still say line 1 `Round N of 3 (fix check)` (owner item 444 a's home, #2342). Fix: pick one form, then make the guard and the docs agree on it, with a red case for the form the docs name.
